name: validate_claim
description: Intercept and validate a factual, mathematical, or scientific claim before presenting it. Returns Coherence Index (0.0-1.0), Confidence Score (0%-100%), and Deterministic Status (VERIFIED_COMPUTED_PASS, REJECTED_HALLUCINATION, BOUNDARY_BREACH, or NEEDS_REVIEW).

claim.description: The text proposition, calculation, or claim to validate.
